title: How a soul.globe Story gets made
subtitle: You do two small things. Everything else happens by itself.

steps.title: Drop a folder in Dropbox
steps.text: Put a video or your photos into a new folder in **“Instagram Stories”** – plus a short note with your wishes, like a link to add.

steps.title: Get a preview on your phone
steps.text: Shortly after, your Story is made and sent to you in **Telegram**, together with the time it would go online.

note.title: Want something different?
note.text: Simply write what should change – you’ll get a new preview, as often as you like.

steps.title: Your Story goes live
steps.text: It appears on **soul.globe** at the next free time of the day:
steps.small: You get a message with the exact time.

promise: Nothing goes online without your OK.
